name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.4: fix stock zeroing on every deploy. The Weimi auto-sync (which runs ~15s after every boot, so every deploy, and every 30 min) rebuilt the layout blob and overwrote currStock with Weimis stale count. For kiosk-owned machines Weimis count no longer reflects real sales, so this clobbered the backends real stock — zeroing it. Sync now preserves currStock for stockSource=kiosk machines (carries forward the prior per-bay count, falling back to Weimi only for a brand-new bay never tracked) while still refreshing codes, products, prices, enable/broken. Weimi-owned machines are unchanged. Also fixes the slower 30-min drift, not just the deploy case. Cumulative over v6.0.3.
